newsitem.title: SPAIN: Gran Canaria cargo traffic up 6.3 percent in March.
newsitem.headline: Gran Canaria cargo traffic up 6.3 percent in March.

text.p: Spain's Gran Canaria airport handled 6.3 percent more cargo in March compared with the same month last year, the airport authority said.
Volume rose to 4,024 tonnes compared with 3,785 tonnes, taking the accumulated total this year to 12,218 tonnes, 19.7 percent more than the same period in 1996.
The airport also handled 472 tonnes of mail in March, 11.5 percent less than in March 1996.

Passenger numbers were 5.8 percent higher in the month at 791,989 excluding transit passengers, taking the accumulated total to 2.16 million, 2.7 percent ahead of 1996. -Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+5017
